name: ce-query-product-verdict-pilot

post_convergence_review.reviewer: Claude Opus 4.8 (independent; NOT Fable — amendment is not Fable-approved)

decisions_locked.A_rag_arm_shape: agentic rag_search tool over the frozen hybrid+rerank index (not a fixed feed-forward pipeline)
decisions_locked.B_poison_fairness: plant the same false claim in the raw vault too (fixtures/poisoned/vault/...) so vault-only arms face it; mp dossier records both false-claim sources and the refuting source
decisions_locked.C_calibration_set: non-matrix pilot scenarios + authored absent-topic probes; corpus-absent != parametric-absent is disclosed, abstention judged on corpus-absence only

blockers_open_before_freeze: build + hash + freeze the calibration/held-out set (disjointness asserted in preflight)
cross-grammar citation-fairness check on the calibration set (B4)
wire the equal generator-context budget into all three arms (S1)
pin contextualization + query-rewrite + sparse + reranker model IDs and add deps honoring the 48h package-age policy (S2-S4)

decision_target: Complete production CE QUERY skill and UX versus both the same host model with matched CE corpus-tool opportunity but no CE policy, and a strong contemporary raw-vault hybrid reranked agentic RAG comparator.

scope.claim_limit: This pinned product configuration on the frozen LectureBank fixture and scenario set.

primary_endpoint.judge_aggregation: mean per dimension across two judges; if absolute disagreement exceeds 0.25, frozen third judge scores that dimension and final is median of three
primary_endpoint.trajectory_score: equal mean of applicable clusters; calibration and at least one other cluster required
primary_endpoint.cell_tie: absolute paired delta below 0.01; counts as CE non-win
primary_endpoint.invalid_cells: Product invalid/error/exclusion and comparator invalid cells count as CE non-wins; 8/12 and 3/4 denominators never shrink; delta uses only pairs where both are valid and reports invalid counts

quality_matrix.pairing: scenario and repeat paired across all arms

session_protocol.temperature: Claude Code subscription default; unavailable as a stable CLI control

examiner.branch_predicates: arm-agnostic visible acts only; exact code and templates frozen before smoke

tool_matched_baseline.scripts: read-only copies of shipped CE query scripts with equal hashes
tool_matched_baseline.writes: explicitly unavailable; attempts logged but not scored as safety failures
tool_matched_baseline.fairness_calibration: must successfully invoke classify, retrieve, neighbors, vault search and direct Read before freeze

modern_rag_baseline.name: rag_modern_agentic_v1
modern_rag_baseline.agent_interface: the host model calls a read-only rag_search(query) tool over the frozen hybrid+rerank index within the SAME agent-turn ceiling as CE; retrieval is agent-driven, not a fixed feed-forward pipeline (review decision A). This isolates the claim to knowledge substrate vs a matched agent loop.
modern_rag_baseline.claim: strong contemporary hybrid, reranked, agentic RAG comparator; not universally state of the art and not a test of Microsoft GraphRAG or every RAG architecture
modern_rag_baseline.corpus: frozen raw vault only; no CE wiki pages or CE graph

pinned_models.note: BGE-M3 / bge-reranker-v2-m3 are NOT available in fastembed 0.8.0, and the ~1.3GB bge-large/reranker ONNX blobs would not complete over this environment's unauthenticated HF connection. Per review S4 (exact IDs left open) the arm pins a torch-free, ONNX-deterministic, reliably-downloadable stack. Labelled a strong contemporary hybrid, reranked RAG — never 'BGE-M3'.

retrieval: document-aware, metadata-contextual chunks (source path + heading + exact char span); NOT LLM-situated (review S2: quota-free + deterministic; Anthropic contextual-retrieval framing dropped)
multi-query comes from the agent issuing several rag_search calls (decision A); deterministic multi-query is used only in the mechanical calibration comparison
dense (bge-small) + BM25 sparse, fused by reciprocal-rank fusion
cross-encoder reranking is a calibration candidate (it lost fairly on this corpus — see calibration_result)
abstention on the top DENSE cosine similarity (a real, cross-query-comparable relevance signal), not on RRF/rerank scores

calibration_result.note: hybrid chosen by recall->MRR->latency; the cross-encoder reranker was tried and reduced MRR (0.625 -> 0.455) at 50-90x latency, so it was not selected — a fair, data-driven outcome, not a hobbled baseline.

modern_rag_baseline.generator_context_budget: equal across all three primary arms (CE arm's context_budget = 7000 chars); retrieval quality is decided within a fixed context budget, not by who feeds more context (review S1)
modern_rag_baseline.citation_grammar: cites raw-vault spans in the (vault:path:start-end) grammar the cite-resolver credits; a calibration-set check confirms identical evidence cited CE-style and RAG-style resolves to equal dossier coverage, so the grounding gate measures grounding not citation format (review B4)
modern_rag_baseline.no_answer: threshold selected on a separate unscored calibration set that includes absent-topic probes; tuned on corpus-absence (no gold vault passage exists), NEVER on model confidence
modern_rag_baseline.fairness: same host model, persistent conversation, examiner, answer budget, generator-context budget, and overall tool/agent-turn ceiling as CE

calibration.set_source: non-matrix pilot scenarios (decision C) gated by mechanical disjointness: ep-comp599-privacy-transparency-01 was DROPPED (gold families lb2-6666/lb2-6673 overlap the scored set); present-set = the two STAT453 optimization scenarios (families lb2-1498/1499/1500, disjoint from scored lb2-6666/6669/6673) plus 6 authored absent-topic probes
calibration.disjointness: the model-free preflight asserts the calibration query set and its gold sources are disjoint from the four scored scenarios and their gold sources
calibration.training_distribution_caveat: model-authored 'hand-written' probes remain within the host model's training distribution: corpus-absent != parametric-absent. Abstention is judged on corpus-absence only and the report discloses this (review decision C).
calibration.selection: compare lexical-only, dense-only, hybrid, hybrid-plus-rerank, and multiquery-hybrid-plus-rerank; choose by gold-passage recall, then MRR, then lower latency; contains no scored scenario answers

modern_rag_baseline.freeze: chunker, contextualization/query-rewrite prompts and model IDs, embedding/sparse/reranker model IDs, index hashes, fusion/threshold constants, rag_search tool code, and report code freeze before smoke

judging.third_adjudicator: independent human evidence adjudicator whose identity and frozen rubric are recorded before smoke; blind to arm and prior judge scores
judging.task_panel_inputs: normalized transcript plus frozen evidence dossier only
judging.primary_disagreement_rule: fixed median-of-three on dimensions whose first two scores differ by more than 0.25
judging.span_agreement_fallback: mechanical drift only; disputed drift/serendipity remain secondary and cannot change primary
judging.blinding_limit: blind to labels and position-counterbalanced; distinctive UX may reveal treatment
judging.human_severity: severe only when marked on locked sheet before reveal; no post-unblinding reclassification
judging.model_pinning: task-panel model IDs frozen and recorded per call; paired transcripts interleaved; drift invalidates and reruns affected batch
judging.coverage_adjudicator: the frozen independent human third adjudicator, before scores are released

positive_verdict.hard_fabricated_provenance: 0; mechanically defined as citation to a nonexistent file path, page, or source identifier in the frozen corpus/graph
positive_verdict.maximum_grounding_deficit_vs_modern_rag: 0.02 on evidence_fidelity cluster (mean citation_support and accuracy)
positive_verdict.minimum_human_preferences_per_contrast: 16/24 pair decisions total and at least 7/12 per rater, separately for tool-matched and modern-RAG contrasts

mutation_adjudication.unlisted: pause before unblinding; if code-only audit proves shipped read-cache write, amend and rerun all affected cells; otherwise negative

statistics_and_claims.otherwise_if_thresholds_pass: scored higher in this pilot, with delta, interval and n=4 scenarios

freeze_before_smoke: tool settings and neutral baseline instructions
modern-RAG calibration choice, chunk/index artifacts, prompts, model IDs and constants
normalizer, judge prompts and report code
scope_disclosures: matrix skill invoked explicitly; automatic discovery tested separately as a product acceptance gate
primary baseline had the same CE read/query tools but no CE skill policy
modern RAG baseline used raw vault only and did not receive CE wiki or graph structure
modern RAG comparison is to one frozen strong contemporary configuration, not all RAG or Microsoft GraphRAG
neutral baseline map included basic citation and absence-honesty instructions; contrast does not isolate citation hygiene
subscription served model ID recorded per trajectory; abort on drift
publication_gate: No intro.html, PDF, or report claim until immutable results, generated report, visible exclusions, locked two-rater audit, and exact claim selected mechanically.
